assumptions: PREVIEW: the published A-F nominal extents and mounting-underside height are the only source dimensions used here. Missing mounting centers, shaft location, shaft diameter and outlet position remain unknown in the source records.

PREVIEW MOUNT: ears extend symmetrically by (E-B)/2 at height F. Ear thickness2mm, slot centers at each ear rectangle midpoint, circular pocket diameter2mm and mouth width1mm are illustrative planning choices.

PREVIEW AXIS: shaft center is placed at [case width/2,case width/2] with diameter5mm as a visual planning choice. This is not a sourced output pose. The shaft-top interval follows the nominal A-C difference without establishing a horn seat.

PREVIEW COVER: the lower housing ends4mm below housing-top C. The two-lobe cover uses main diameter equal to case width, secondary diameter6mm and secondary X offset5mm. These round-number contour choices are illustrative, not a conservative housing envelope.

PREVIEW EXIT: the outlet is placed on the X0 face at Y=width/2, default height2mm. Wire diameter1mm and pitch1.1mm are planning inputs. The default3mm displayed segment marks the cable entrance rather than the full published lead length.
Cable bundle/conductor counts retain their separate source evidence. Connector10 x8 x4mm is optional planning geometry, omitted by default; its dimensions and position are not manufacturer data.

Amber mounting ears and shaft identify unverified placement. Housing and conductor colors are visual cues, not material or manufacturing-finish specifications. No FS90 dimensions or mechanical compatibility are assigned to this source profile.

mount_groups.note: Two screw reference circles, not closed holes in the servo: the drawing depicts open mounting slots. Origin is the near mounting center in the ear underside plane; +X points to the far center; +Z points toward output shaft. Pattern does not register envelope boxes automatically.

observations.note: Linear callouts explicitly carry +/-0.1 mm. Circle diameters 2.2 and 4.86 do not. 21 teeth alone does not establish horn compatibility. This profile does not claim equivalence to older FS90-C drawings or all FS90-branded products.

missing_mount_dimensions: Mounting pitch conflicts: direct 29 versus chained 28.6
Mounting tolerance and exact slot contour

observations.note: The mounting pitch has an internal 29 vs 28.6 conflict. No mounting pattern is offered. The case-frame shaft X uses only the independent chain 1.9 + 8.75 - 4.85 = 5.8. The printed 6.0 is between two top-boss centers, and diameter 5.4 describes the secondary boss, not the output shaft. No dimensions or cable facts are inherited from TowerPro source profiles. TA0132 is the source-document identifier; a physical product revision and exact seller SKU have not been established.

evidence.note: Case minimum corner datum. X=1.9+8.75-4.85=5.8 is subtraction-derived; Y=6.05 is directly dimensioned. Z=0 defines the case base. Source mounting-pitch contradiction is retained and not used for this case-frame derivation. No tolerances are published.
